$comment: drain.mqInfraSignatures: nonempty array of regex source strings for same-head failed_checks job-log infrastructure evidence. Standard default: ["could not fetch \S+ from promisor remote"]. Resolve standard → platform drain → tool drain → WE_DRAIN_MQ_INFRA_SIGNATURES (JSON array), logging effective value and source through policy-cascade. Sources must parse entirely as ASCII letters, digits, spaces, escaped ASCII punctuation, or the wildcard tokens \S+, \d+, \s+ only. Require at least 10 ASCII alphanumeric characters and at least 11 literal letters/digits/spaces, at most one wildcard, and no adjacent wildcards. A non-space wildcard must be followed by a space, escaped punctuation, or end; a whitespace wildcard by a non-space or end; a digit wildcard by a non-digit or end; compile-check every source. Unknown syntax is rejected; invalid overrides fall back to the next valid layer. At most 32 sources, 200 characters each. At most ten failed jobs; more jobs or unreadable/empty/non-text logs hold with operator inspection. Log exec uses maxBuffer=4 MiB and scans only the final 64 KiB of returned text (UTF-8 bytes); scan each newline-delimited line only within its last 512 characters. A signature outside these bounds cannot authorize retry; operators must inspect failed jobs and enqueue manually when no infrastructure evidence remains. The existing single-retry, CLEAN PR and newest-completed-green-main requirements remain in force. drain.mqAggregateJobs: nonempty array of at most 16 plain job names, at most 80 characters each (ASCII letters/digits, spaces, underscores and hyphens; starts with a letter/digit). Standard default: ["test", "coverage-merge"]. Resolve standard → platform drain → tool drain → WE_DRAIN_MQ_AGGREGATE_JOBS (JSON array), logging effective value and source through policy-cascade; invalid overrides fall back to the next valid layer. Match the final workflow-qualified check name exactly. Fetch bounded Actions job metadata using the repository-validated details_url job ID, never the check-run ID. Require matching Actions job ID, completed failure status/conclusion, job name and merge-group head SHA and a nonempty readable steps array with at least one failure of the designated dependency step and containing only passing/skipped/neutral steps or the exact dependency-only failed step (test: Gate on shard results; coverage-merge: Require successful shards). Intrinsic failures and unreadable/invalid metadata require ordinary log evidence. Derived aggregates skip log reads; at least one non-derived failure must remain and every non-derived failure must satisfy existing infrastructure evidence rules. Aggregate-only failures hold for operator inspection and manual enqueue. Keep the ten-failed-job cap before any metadata/log read and the shared 20-call evidence budget (including metadata, logs and main pages); exhaustion holds for operator inspection. Accepts and declines name skipped derived aggregates and the deciding main run.
